name: Separator
description: A thin line between sections or between controls in a row, hidden from assistive technology unless `decorative` is false.

orientation.description: Draws a horizontal line across the available width, or a vertical line down the height of its row and at least one control tall.

decorative.description: Hides the line from assistive technology; `false` exposes it as a separator with its orientation, for a break between sections or a resize handle.

membrane.description: Insets the line by the control spacing on every side, so its ends line up with the visible edges of neighbouring controls.

aria.role: none while decorative; separator with aria-orientation from orientation when decorative is false. A role or aria-orientation passed as an attribute is ignored.
notes: A window splitter is a separator that is not decorative with tabIndex, aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-controls and a name; they and its key handlers are native attributes of the line.
The line is --uf-separator-line-width thick and does not scale with membrane spacing.
Membrane insets the line by --uf-membrane on every side, so its ends meet the visible edges of neighbouring controls.
A vertical line stretches with its row and is at least --uf-control-height tall; a horizontal one in a row fills the space its siblings leave.
In forced colors the line is drawn in CanvasText.

whenToUse: Rule between a card or panel heading and its fields
Divider between groups of controls in a toolbar
Break between content sections, with decorative={false}
Resize handle between panes, with decorative={false} and the window-splitter attributes
whenNotToUse: Groups in a Menu (use a { type: 'separator' } item)
